easter.verse1:
You are the light of the world.
A city set on a hill cannot be hidden.
easter.title: The Story of Those Who Made This
easter.story1:
One of us was a marketer.
After six years of work, the question of what work means had stayed with him for a long time.
easter.story2:
After prayer, one question remained.
"Could technology like AI serve the church and the faith of Christians?"
easter.story3: Carrying that question, he looked for a fellow worker.
easter.story4:
The other was a developer.
He admired the way startups solve the world's problems,
yet had not first sought what the Lord desired on that path.
He spent three years waiting for the Lord's timing.
easter.story5:
One winter, on a day of futsal outreach,
a small idea shared by a brother became a spark.
From that spark, 'ONGI' was first sketched.
easter.story6:
And so it began.
Asking for nothing in return —
simply to discern what is pleasing to the Lord.
easter.story7:
We hope this app becomes the light of prayers
rising from every corner of the world.
easter.verse2:
So that you may approve what is excellent,
filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ,
to the glory and praise of God.

levels.name: Booth
levels.about: A shelter roofed with branches, built at the Feast of Booths to remember the wilderness.
levels.verse: You shall dwell in booths for seven days

levels.name: Tabernacle
levels.about: The tent of meeting in the wilderness: a courtyard, an altar, and a sanctuary where God dwelt among His people.
levels.verse: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell in their midst

levels.name: House Church
levels.about: The early church met in homes. The 3rd century house church at Dura-Europos is the oldest church building we know.
levels.verse: Breaking bread in their homes, they received their food with glad and generous hearts

levels.name: Basilica
levels.about: After Christianity was legalized in the 4th century, the first large churches borrowed the form of the Roman hall.
levels.verse: Christ Jesus himself being the cornerstone

levels.name: Romanesque
levels.about: 11th century Europe. Thick stone walls, round arches, and a heavy bell tower at the heart of the village.
levels.verse: On this rock I will build my church

levels.name: Gothic Cathedral
levels.about: 12th to 16th century. Soaring spires, rose windows and stained glass that brought light inside.
levels.verse: Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary

levels.name: Sagrada Família
levels.about: Begun in Barcelona in 1882 and still being built together more than 140 years later.
levels.verse: In him you also are being built together into a dwelling place for God by the Spirit

levels.name: Church of the Light
levels.about: Modern. A wall opened in the shape of a cross so light can pour in.
levels.verse: You are the light of the world
